summary: Frontend-only verification of Luchii video/music model naming + gallery model filter. All checks pass. /models page shows 3 new Luchii cards: 'Luchii Cinematica', 'Luchii Animus', 'Luchii Harmonia'. /gallery Images tab shows filter chips [All, Luchii Dreamline, Luchii Nova-Muse, Luchii Painter-X, Luchii Prime]; seeded TEST-flt-0..3 badges read Nova-Muse/Dreamline/Painter-X/Prime respectively; clicking gallery-model-filter-luchii-prime shows only TEST-flt-3, and gallery-model-filter-all restores all 4. Videos tab shows gallery-video-luchii-badge-TEST-fltv-0='Luchii Cinematica' and TEST-fltv-1='Luchii Animus'; filter chips [All, Luchii Animus, Luchii Cinematica] correctly isolate the matching clip. /v/TEST-fltv-1 video-share-luchii-badge = 'Luchii Animus'. Regression: nav-about-luchii present on home nav.
critical_code_review_comments: LuchiiBadge.luchiiModelFor correctly maps kind='video' with mode='image-to-video' -> 'Luchii Animus', else 'Luchii Cinematica'; kind='music' -> 'Luchii Harmonia'. Image mappings unchanged.
Gallery.ModelFilter uses deterministic sorted options with a stable testid slug (toLowerCase + non-alnum -> '-'), which matches the requested selectors (gallery-model-filter-luchii-prime etc.).
useModelFilter falls back to 'All' when the active model is no longer in options (good for tab switching).
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded TEST-flt-0..3 (generations) and TEST-fltv-0/1 (jobs) in test_database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow unchanged: fetch /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('luchii_token', token). Gallery image filter testids are slugified labels: luchii-nova-muse, luchii-painter-x, luchii-prime, luchii-dreamline, luchii-animus, luchii-cinematica, luchii-harmonia; the 'All' chip is gallery-model-filter-all.
